verdict.rationale: Firebase documents real-time data sync and listeners (store and sync app data, listen to data). A hands-on community report describes syncing positions to multiple clients at once, which approximates broadcasting shared state through database sync. Nothing in the pack documents presence tracking or a dedicated ephemeral (non-persisted) broadcast channel. Missing for 10: documented presence/connection-state tracking (e.g., disconnect handling), a dedicated ephemeral broadcast mechanism, first-party docs specific to this use case.
